# HugeRTE, vendored

Rich text editor for the pack's document panels.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/hugerte/hugerte>
- Version 1.0.12, npm `hugerte@1.0.12`
- Licence: MIT, retained in `license.txt` beside this file. DOMPurify 3.4.11, compiled into
  `hugerte.min.mjs` and `themes/silver/theme.min.mjs`, is `MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0`, retained in
  `LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt` and `LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt`

Every file taken from the package is byte for byte the published file. `README.md` beside
this file lists them with the licence each one carries.
